name: Abel
summary: The second son of Adam and Eve, a shepherd whose offering the LORD accepted. His brother Cain killed him in a field.

key_moments.title: A Shepherd's Offering
key_moments.description: Abel kept sheep. He brought the LORD the firstborn of his flock and their fat, and the LORD accepted Abel and his gift.

key_moments.title: Killed by His Brother
key_moments.description: Cain attacked Abel in the field and killed him. The LORD told Cain that his brother's blood was crying out to Him from the ground.

key_moments.title: Faith That Still Speaks
key_moments.description: By faith Abel offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did, and God showed that Abel was righteous. Though he died, through his faith he still speaks.
